cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm not asking you to apologise for cancelling the party. Remember the apology letters I helped you write? Name what you did. You didn't tell me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you let me arrive with a cake. You used to put the kind reason first in those letters too. Try the action.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nearly. The party isn't writing the apology. Start with 'I let you come without telling you'.
